title: Verity County Regional Careers Portal
description: A hiring page that is not one: work-from-home offers under the names of Verity Valley Power & Light and County General, an offer letter with the applicant's name still in the merge field, and a refundable verification deposit that has to be paid in gift cards.

blocks.text: *** IMMEDIATE START *** 4 POSITIONS REMAINING IN {{city}} *** NO EXPERIENCE REQUIRED *** APPLY BEFORE {{deadline_date}} ***

blocks.body:
Welcome to the official employment portal for Verity County, {{state}}. The Portal is an authorised hiring partner of [b]Verity Valley Power & Light[/b], County General Health System and eleven other regional employers, and has placed over 12,000 residents into full time work since 2011.

Positions are filled on a first-verified basis. Applicants who complete [url=/verify]Applicant Verification[/url] first are placed first.

Every position above includes medical and dental from day one, weekly pay by direct deposit, and a laptop, printer and headset shipped to your home address at no cost to you.*

[i]*A refundable equipment and identity verification deposit applies. See [url=/verify]Step 3[/url].[/i]

items: Submit your name, address and telephone number. No resume is required.
Interview by text message with a hiring manager. Nine minutes, most applicants pass.
Applicant Verification. Identity, banking and the equipment deposit.

blocks.body: Hiring managers are online [b]now[/b]. Step 2 is conducted entirely by text message; do not telephone, as our recruiters are in the field.

Our employer rating of 4.9 out of 5 is independently confirmed at [url=synth://trusted-employer-ratings.vip/verity-careers-portal]Trusted Employer Ratings[/url], and Verity Valley Power & Light posts its own openings through us at [url=synth://vvpl-careers-hr.click/openings]vvpl-careers-hr.click[/url].

Portal office: 118 Mill Street, Suite 4, Gridfall. Applicant line 782-0119, Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm EST.

Date: Tuesday, 15 September 2026
Reference: VCP-{{application_id}}

Dear {{applicant_first_name}},

Congratulations! Following your successful interview with our hiring team, {{company_name}} is pleased to offer you the position of {{position_title}}. You were selected from 412 applicants in the {{city}} area.

Your onboarding must be completed within 24 hours of receipt of this letter or the position will be released to the next candidate on the list.

head: OFFER SUMMARY
rows: Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm EST (overnight shift)
Laptop, printer, headset, shipped from our {{warehouse_city}} facility

blocks.body: Verity Valley Power & Light is the largest employer in Verity County, with over 900 employees serving 41,000 homes. The company rebuilt its Gridfall substation following the 2004 lightning fire that claimed the lives of two firefighters, and has invested heavily in community safety ever since. We are proud to recruit on their behalf.

Sincerely,

{{hr_rep_name}}
Senior Recruitment Officer
Verity County Regional Careers Portal
Direct: 1-888-441-0092 (voicemail only)

[i]This letter was generated automatically. Do not reply to this address. {{template_error_undefined_ref}}[/i]

[b]Next step:[/b] [url=/verify]complete Applicant Verification, Step 3 of 4[/url]. Your offer expires in {{hours_remaining}} hours.

Your W-4 and I-9 are available for download at [url=synth://onboarding-docs-verity.zip/forms]onboarding-docs-verity.zip[/url]. Print both, sign, and photograph them with your telephone.

Before equipment can be released to your address, the Portal is required to verify your identity and to hold a deposit against the hardware being shipped. The deposit is [b]$48.50[/b] and is returned in full with your first weekly pay.

items: Your full legal name, as it appears on your identification.
A photograph of your driver's licence, front and back, held in your hand.
Your bank routing number and account number. Checking accounts are processed faster than savings.
The name of your branch and its telephone number.
A photograph of your debit card, front and back, with the signature strip visible.
Your mother's maiden name, for security.

blocks.body:
The deposit may be paid by prepaid gift card, which is the fastest method, by transfer through an app, or by money order. Card numbers may be photographed and sent to your recruiter by text message. [b]Do not send cash in the post.[/b]

Payment is processed by our secure partner at [url=synth://verity-payroll-direct.finance/enroll]Verity Payroll Direct[/url]. If that page does not load, use the alternate processor at [url=synth://vcp-verify-secure.top/step3]vcp-verify-secure.top[/url]. Both are safe and encrypted.

Verification status may be checked at [url=synth://county-jobs-verify.win/status]county-jobs-verify.win[/url] with the reference number from your [url=/offer]offer letter[/url].
[i]Applicants who complete verification before {{deadline_date}} also receive a $250 signing bonus, paid with the first cheque.[/i]

entries.author: Verity Jobs Daily
entries.body: Residents of {{city}} are encouraged to apply. This employer has been recognized by local officials for its commitment to the community and continues to hire across the {{city}} area. Apply today.

entries.author: Tanya M.
entries.body: I paid the $48.50 on Wednesday and then the text said there was a background check for $79, and after that a payroll enrolment for $22.50. That is when I rang the bank. The bank stopped the card. I am out $48.50 and the pictures of my licence, and the licence is the part I am sick about.

entries.body: There is no such job. My mother got this same letter with a different account number on it and the same reference number as mine. Ring the sheriff's non-emergency line, 782-1200, and make the report even if you did not pay them anything. They are counting.

entries.author: Hiring Team
entries.body: Positions remain available. Complete Step 3 to secure your start date of {{start_date}}.

blocks.text: Is this the county's own website?

blocks.body: The Portal is an independent authorized hiring partner and is not affiliated with any government agency, employer or utility named on this site. All listings are with verified employers in {{city}}, {{state}}.
The deposit protects our employer partners against the loss of equipment shipped to a home address. It is standard across the industry and is fully refundable.

blocks.text: When do I get the deposit back?

blocks.body: With your first weekly pay, issued the Friday after your start date of {{start_date}}.

Shipping from our {{warehouse_city}} facility takes 3 to 5 business days. Track your shipment at [url=synth://onboarding-docs-verity.zip/tracking]onboarding-docs-verity.zip[/url]. If tracking shows no movement after ten days, a second deposit may be required to release a replacement unit.

blocks.text: Can I speak to someone by telephone?

blocks.body: All communication is conducted by text message, for the safety and convenience of our applicants. The office at 118 Mill Street is not open to the public and does not accept walk-in applicants.

blocks.text: I am already employed by Verity Valley Power & Light.

Bright Meadow Dental Group, PLLC ("the Practice") is committed to protecting the privacy of our patients. This notice describes how medical information about you may be used and disclosed and how you can get access to this information. Please review it carefully.

The Practice may use your treatment records, radiographs and appointment history for treatment, payment and health care operations as permitted under HIPAA. We may disclose information to a dental laboratory in order to fabricate a restoration, and to your insurance carrier in order to obtain payment for services rendered.

We may contact you by telephone, text message or postcard to remind you of a scheduled cleaning or to inform you that your six month recall is due. If you do not wish to receive reminders, tell the front desk at check-in.

A copy of this notice is posted in the reception area at each of our four locations and is available from the front desk on request. Our locations and hours are listed at [url=synth://brightmeadowdental.biz/patients]brightmeadowdental.biz[/url].

Residents of California may request a list of third parties to whom personal information was disclosed for direct marketing purposes in the preceding calendar year. Direct requests to the Practice Privacy Officer, Dr. {{provider_name}}, at the address on the Contact page.
